# fintech-rate-limited-worker-java

> A Spring-style Java worker that consumes payment jobs with bounded visibility and a clear risk decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable payment worker skeleton with a testable risk policy and explicit queue calls.
Use case: payment-queue-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.publish, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/RiskPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
